verdict.rationale: Convex's pricing page lists 'Daily backups' as a feature (convex-docs-37), and the CLI offers `npx convex import` to load data from a file (convex-docs-26), which suggests a basic restore path. The pack does not document how backups are configured, retained, or restored. It also never mentions point-in-time recovery, so only the automated-backup half of the story is evidenced, and thinly. Missing for 10: point-in-time recovery, documented backup retention/restore workflow, confirmation of which plans include backups, independent or hands-on corroboration.
